<!-- pr-reviewer: 0a475f405a34b41543ea7ed733267f857c03f485 -->
Clean review. No blocking findings. The PR is MERGEABLE.

I read the complete diff and checked the laws in current upstream/main, fc5edab05c546eefd92e260843d410150e105670. The local trial merge is e63d2681c4b9aeba49863cf14f04506adfff0304. Its first parent is the PR head.

The change preserves all committed fixture, golden, snapshot, and binary bytes. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, or stock simulation. This is not a safety-tier review. No mutations apply. No UI screenshots are required.

**Local build and tests**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The plan selects no crate tests for this one-file change.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test example_line_endings`: all 3 named pinning tests passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed. The release build and all 11 tests passed across five suites. The gate reports 6 steps, 0 failures, and 0 stalls.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.

**Extra suites run**

`example_line_endings` ran in full. No importer code, test data, post, operation, motion, or catalog file changed. The additional kernel and catalog suites do not apply.

I also checked all 5,175 tracked regular files with `git checkout-index`, under both `core.autocrlf=false` and `core.autocrlf=true`. Every checkout matched its committed blob. All 245 files that contain NUL bytes stayed unchanged. None has forced text attributes. PNG, ICO, and SC files retain binary attributes. Current STEP and STL files under `testdata/` are ASCII text and retain their LF rules.

**Pre-existing failure, non-blocking**

`RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` fails at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` with `clippy::needless_bool`. I ran the same command on bare upstream/main fc5edab05. It fails with the same diagnostic. This PR does not change that file. No open issue that names this diagnostic was found.

**Existing CRLF files**

The checkout audit confirms that this PR preserves the existing CRLF bytes. For the separate normalization work requested in #3795, these text files contain CRLF:

- `crates/app/src/setup_post_options.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/first_traverse.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/lathe_post_turn_radius.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_fit.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/wire_sync_viewport.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/pick_highlight_mesh_tests.rs`
- `examples/catalog/3d/rough-finish/model/gen_rough_finish_obj.py`

The intentional CRLF goldens also stay unchanged: `CCSEP20.ISO`, `CCSEP20.SBL`, and `CCSEP20.SBR` under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/`; `CCSEP20.SBL`, `CCSEP20.SBR`, and `DIE20.SBL` under `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/`.

No change is requested before merge. Per the review request, I left the labels, title, and draft state unchanged. The review worktree and branch remain available for reuse.

Author: please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 3844 -R NeoTech/Camcraft`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
